entries.name: S&M DW9
entries.imageCaption: The larger weapon on the right, pictured with the Vintage Vice City Weapon Pattern.
entries.description: A compact submachine gun pictured in Rockstar’s Vintage Vice City Weapon Pattern artwork.
entries.influencePreview: GTABase identifies the Brügger & Thomet APC9 K PRO as its real-world design influence.
entries.whereToFind: The weapon is visible in official artwork. Its acquisition route and exact locations will be checked at release.
entries.unlock: The artwork promotes a weapon pattern; it does not establish that the underlying weapon is exclusive to that pack.
entries.performance: Ammo capacity, damage, recoil and range are awaiting release confirmation.

stagedButNotRecommended.name: Albany Buccaneer
stagedButNotRecommended.influence: GTABase identifies Ford Fairlane and Buick Riviera styling.
stagedButNotRecommended.evidence: GTABase identifies a Trailer 1 appearance. Downloaded image shows green lowrider with Buccaneer badge.
stagedButNotRecommended.holdReason: Image is promotional imagery republished by GTABase; direct Rockstar source for this exact image still needs resolving. Do not call it a verified gameplay screenshot. Do not transfer listed legacy-looking mass/gears/performance.
